content.text: 30-second cinematic short about Mei, a young female street muralist in her late twenties, painting a giant mural of a phoenix on a rain-soaked alley wall at midnight under neon-lit signs. Cool wet pavement, cyberpunk teal-and-magenta palette, breath visible in the cold air.
